prompt: The new version runs on a full second set of servers, then the load balancer flips all traffic to it.
why: Two environments and an instant switch is blue-green.
trap: Canary sends a little traffic first; this switches it all.

prompt: When errors spiked, they pointed traffic back at the old environment within seconds.
tells: pointed traffic back at the old environment
trap: It is a rollback, but the clue is the second environment.

prompt: Running two full copies of production during each release doubles server cost briefly.
Both environments share one database, so the schema must work for old and new code.
tells: must work for old and new code
trap: It's a deploy concern, not configuration.

prompt: The team tests the idle green environment before switching users to it.
why: Testing the new environment before the switch is part of blue-green.
trap: No users see it yet, unlike a canary.

prompt: Switching by DNS took an hour for some users because of cached records.
tells: Switching by DNS took an hour
why: Blue-green needs a fast switch, like a load balancer, not slow DNS.
trap: It's the switch mechanism of blue-green.
